name: FrontierSWE V2
notes: Per-task and per-trial quality, cost, and wall time with trace links; 34 high-difficulty tasks, 5 trials, 20-hour cap. Strongest direct Pareto source; scores have wide intervals.

name: SWE-rebench
access_notes: Leaderboard crawl exceeds browser extraction size; searched and attempted open. Raw task/results dataset available on Hugging Face.
notes: Fresh real GitHub issues; publishes resolved rate and cost per problem. Track time window and harness; leaderboard rows are model or agent runs.

name: SWE-bench Pro
notes: Long-horizon repository tasks; eval papers and vendor reports vary by harness. Dataset card is the opened leaderboard/eval source.

name: SWE-bench Verified
notes: stale: widely cited legacy baseline; OpenAI documented material test defects and stopped using it for frontier evaluation. Keep for historical comparability only.

name: SWE-bench Multilingual
notes: 300 tasks across 9 languages; current family leaderboard. Only a limited common-harness model set may be available.

name: SWE-bench Multimodal
notes: Repository issue-resolution tasks with visual elements; verify current submission coverage before routing.

name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
notes: Current board reports resolution rate, total cost, tokens, and agent. The page renders model rows dynamically; submissions are harness-dependent.

name: TerminalWorld
notes: Real recorded terminal workflows; standardized Terminus-2. Search result reports total cost and cost/pass; published page has 200-task verified score table. Older update than leading boards.

name: TUA-Bench
notes: 120 real-world executable terminal-use tasks, including everyday workflows and scientific tools; compares agent and model and reports reasoning setting.

name: Aider Polyglot
notes: Practical code-editing benchmark; model results can be dated and task/version-specific. Cost is estimated from token use and published prices.

name: LiveCodeBench
notes: Rolling contest problems across coding, math, and reasoning reduce contamination; leaderboard versions and problem date windows matter.

name: ProgramBench
notes: Meaningful software artifact generation from scratch; complements issue-fix benchmarks.

name: CodeClash
notes: Goal-oriented software development evaluation, not just isolated issue resolution; check latest submission activity.

name: APEX-SWE
notes: Integration and observability work, graded by expert rubrics plus tests; economically grounded SWE complement to repo issue benchmarks.

name: METR Time Horizon
notes: Reports estimated human task-duration horizon at 50% success, not wall-clock runtime. Independent capability trend; do not treat as per-task latency.

name: WebDev Arena
notes: Blind human preference on generated interactive web apps. Crowd ELO is useful for frontend quality, not functional verification; blog describes scope and voting method. Same live leaderboard as code-arena (arena.ai merged WebDev into Code Arena); kept for history, excluded from reports.

name: Code Arena
access_notes: Leaderboard content is JS-rendered.
notes: Crowd preference leaderboard for coding outputs; use alongside executable coding benchmarks.

name: Design2Code
notes: stale: canonical screenshot-to-code benchmark remains a useful cited baseline, but published model coverage predates current frontier models.

name: UIBenchKit
access_notes: Page opened but returned no extractable body; verify UI and downloadable result files in collector browser.
notes: Claims unified design-to-code leaderboard using DCGen and Design2Code; current frontier coverage and raw-result access require follow-up.

name: WebArena
notes: Interactive website task benchmark; compare only same split, environment, and browser-agent harness. Leaderboard coverage is fragmented.

name: WebVoyager
notes: Public harness and results exist, but original live-site tasks are time-sensitive and recent reproductions patch/remove tasks; treat raw headline scores as non-comparable.

name: OSWorld 2.0
notes: Long-horizon real computer workflows; opened leaderboard exposes score and some cost results. Agent scaffold, desktop environment, and task version strongly affect score.

name: GDPval
notes: Vendor-originated occupational work benchmark, but evaluates multiple model makers. Expert preference win/tie quality with inference time and API-cost comparisons; 220-task open gold set.

name: APEX-1 / AI Productivity Index
notes: Occupational tasks for investment banking, consulting, big law, and primary-care medicine; held-out scores plus open 100-task slice and eval harness. No task cost/time disclosed on leaderboard.

name: FinanceBenchmark
notes: Aggregates finance QA, numerical reasoning, and finance-agent evaluations; mixed-source model claims and uneven coverage. Prefer underlying benchmark records when available.

name: FinanceBench
notes: stale: widely cited SEC-document QA baseline; current aggregator contains newer submissions, but task set is fixed and retrieval/scaffold changes dominate system scores.

name: FinQA
notes: stale: foundational numerical reasoning benchmark still reported in finance model comparisons; fixed dataset and susceptible to saturation.

name: LegalBench
notes: Broad US legal reasoning task suite with current Vals-run model leaderboard; classification-heavy and not a measure of safe legal advice or full drafting.

name: LEXam
notes: Law-school examination tasks with open-ended and multiple-choice tracks; current page includes frontier results, but coverage and evaluation judge matter.

name: LiveBench
notes: Frequently refreshed objective tasks spanning math, coding, reasoning, language, instruction following, and data analysis. Track release snapshot.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
owner: Center for AI Safety / Scale AI
notes: Very difficult cross-domain expert questions; distinguish no-tools from tool-assisted settings and multimodal slices.

name: GPQA Diamond
notes: Graduate-level science QA; use Diamond subset and comparable prompting. New clean leaderboard emphasizes provenance and independently run evaluations.

name: MMLU-Pro
access_notes: Space page opened; leaderboard display may require JavaScript.
notes: Broad 14-discipline knowledge/reasoning benchmark with official Hugging Face leaderboard API support.

name: MathArena
notes: Rolling fresh competition problems (AIME, HMMT, USAMO/IMO and research math); track exact contest and tool/effort configuration.

name: SciCode
notes: Scientist-curated scientific coding tasks; leaderboard has 55+ model entries and uncertainty intervals; recent SciCode-Verified paper flags benchmark defects, so track version.

name: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard V4
notes: Publishes whole-benchmark estimated USD cost and latency in seconds, alongside accuracy; V4 adds multi-turn/agentic scenarios. Last update seen Apr 12.

name: τ-bench / τ²-bench
notes: Multi-turn tool-agent-user tasks across retail, airline, telecom and banking. July grading update changed banking scores; version-pin rows.

name: Toolathlon
notes: Diverse realistic long-horizon task execution; verified task release and trajectories available on Hugging Face.

name: Artificial Analysis Long Context Reasoning (AA-LCR)
notes: Independent standardized cross-document reasoning at about 100k tokens; current model table includes AA-LCR field. API has model benchmark metrics; avoid treating this as context-window maximum test.

name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and model leaderboard
notes: Broad independently run aggregate plus standardized speed, latency, throughput and price measurements; preserve index version and constituent benchmark scores, not only headline rank.

name: Artificial Analysis Search API Index
notes: Compares search providers through a standardized agent/model/harness with task success, end-to-end time and cost; evaluates tool/provider stack, not only language model.

name: IFBench
owner: Allen Institute for AI / Artificial Analysis
notes: Verifiable out-of-domain instruction constraints; standardized AA-run result field. Do not conflate with IFEval scores.

name: LMArena Text Arena
notes: Large-scale blind pairwise human votes and Elo-style rankings; prompt mix, style preference, and voting population differ from task success.

name: Latitude Coding-Agent Benchmark
notes: Same agent loop on planted JavaScript bugs; publishes solve rate, cost per solved task, wall time, first-tool latency, tool reliability, and raw per-run JSONL with traces. Small task set; independent but built by a developer-tools vendor.

name: RealDataAgentBench (RDAB)
access_notes: Leaderboard table is dynamically populated; static page confirms 39 tasks, 12 models, per-task cost and score-per-dollar columns.
notes: Real-data analysis workflows scored on correctness, code quality, efficiency, and statistical validity. Strong niche white-collar/data-science view; require coverage counts before cross-model ranking.

name: ARC Prize Leaderboard

name: SimpleBench

notes: added by coverage audit 2026-09-22. Common-sense trick-question MCQ plus a small open-ended board. cost_usd is the source's own cost-per-run estimate from list pricing; null where the source lacks one. last_updated is the capture date.

notes: added by coverage audit 2026-09-22. Index v1.2 plus 7 components, cost and latency paired; about 6 weeks older than the main Vals Index.
